title: Organization handles
description: Which platform accounts and domains an organization publishes under -- ownership evidence for identity resolution, never joined for scores or adoption. Kept as its own file, outside sources/organizations/*.yaml, so a handle edit never re-keys declaration_version_id: an organization's own record (name, products, homepage, github) IS the declaration and belongs in the digest, but who owns which account is a fact ABOUT that declaration, established independently and revisable without touching it. See docs/reference/identity.md and build/declaration_version.py::NON_DECLARATION_INPUTS.

version.description: Schema version. Bump only on a breaking shape change.

org.description: The organization slug. Must resolve to a real sources/organizations/<org>.yaml.

platform.description: Which platform this handle names an account or domain on.

handle.description: The account name (github, huggingface) or domain (homepage_domain), in its declared casing. build/validate.py enforces that one (platform, folded handle) maps to exactly one org -- folded by casefold, and homepage_domain additionally strips a leading `www.`.

note.description: Optional: why this handle is assigned here rather than elsewhere -- e.g. it is shared with a sibling org record, or it was recovered from a repo-level URL rather than an account page.
